introHtml: Swannies golf polo shirts bring a classic, preppy look to your corporate apparel. Made from performance fabrics that wick moisture and resist wrinkles, these polos keep your team comfortable on the course or at the office. With custom embroidery available on the chest or sleeve, you can add your logo in contrasting thread colors that pop against the shirt's traditional stripes and solids. Ideal for company golf tournaments, client gifts, or uniform programs.
